title: Workflow example: clean, aggregate by category, then sort by result
description: A three-step workflow that removes missing values, groups rows by a categorical column with sum aggregation, then sorts the result in descending order. This is the most common analysis pattern for 'which category has the highest total'. Use this as a template when the user asks to compare totals across categories, regions, or groups.
example_query: 按地区统计销售总额，从高到低排列
planning_notes: Step 1 cleans missing values first so they do not affect the aggregation. Step 2 computes total sales per region. Step 3 sorts descending so the highest-sales region appears first. Do not skip step 1 if the dataset may contain missing values in the target column.
